questions.question: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.explain: A cube has 6 flat square faces. A common mix-up is to swap the number of faces (6) with the number of vertices (8).

questions.question: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges, and 8 vertices. Which shape has the same counts?
questions.explain: A box shape (rectangular prism) also has 6 faces, 12 edges, and 8 vertices. Balls, cones, and tubes have curved parts, so their counts are different.

questions.question: What makes a cube different from a regular rectangular prism?
questions.explain: A cube is special because all 6 of its faces are the same size. A regular prism has some faces that are bigger than others.

questions.question: Mia stacks 4 sugar cubes in a row. The new shape she makes is a ___.
questions.explain: Stacking cubes in a row makes a rectangular prism, which looks like a long box. It is not round or pointy.

questions.question: Sam says, 'A cube is not a prism because it looks square.' What is wrong with what Sam says?
options: A cube is a prism too
A cube has no straight edges
questions.explain: A cube is a special rectangular prism where all faces are the same size. Saying it is not a prism just because it looks square is the mistake.

questions.question: A box of markers is a rectangular prism. If you make all its sides the same length, it becomes a ___.
questions.explain: When all sides of a rectangular prism are the same length, it becomes a cube. It is still a prism, just a special one.

questions.question: A cube has 12 edges and 8 vertices. A rectangular prism also has 12 edges and 8 vertices. How many MORE faces does the rectangular prism have than the cube?
questions.explain: Both a cube and a rectangular prism have 6 faces, so the rectangular prism has 0 MORE. The trap is thinking the different shape means different face counts.

questions.question: Tom has 3 sugar cubes and 1 tissue box. The cubes are cubes. The tissue box is a rectangular prism. How many of his objects are also rectangular prisms?
questions.explain: All 4 are rectangular prisms because a cube IS a special rectangular prism. The trap is to count only the tissue box and say 1.

questions.question: A student writes: 'A cube has 6 faces, 8 edges, and 12 vertices.' What went wrong?
questions.explain: A cube has 12 edges and 8 vertices. The student swapped the edge count with the vertex count. That is the most common mix-up.

questions.question: Which sentence about a cube is true?
options: It is not a prism at all
questions.explain: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, and all its faces are rectangles, so it is a special rectangular prism. Many children swap the counts and say 8 faces, but 8 is the number of corners.

questions.question: Which counts are right for a cube and also for a rectangular prism?
questions.explain: Both shapes have 6 flat faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. The 6 always goes with the faces and the 8 always goes with the corners, so do not swap them.

questions.question: Is a cube a rectangular prism? Why?
options: No, all its faces are squares
Yes, it is a special prism
questions.explain: A square is a rectangle with equal sides, so a cube's 6 square faces still make it a rectangular prism. It is the special one where every edge is the same length.

questions.question: A cube has 8 vertices. How many vertices does a rectangular prism have?
questions.explain: A rectangular prism has 8 vertices, just like a cube, so this is one way they are alike. The 6 is how many faces it has and the 12 is how many edges.

questions.question: Maya's lunch box is a cube. Her brother's lunch box is longer, with 6 rectangle faces. Which sentence is true?
options: Only the long box is a prism
questions.explain: A cube's faces are squares, and squares are rectangles, so both lunch boxes are rectangular prisms. A cube has 6 faces, not 8; the 8 counts its corners.

questions.question: Ella wants to show that her sugar cube is a rectangular prism. Which check works best?
options: See if its faces are not squares
See if it has 8 faces and 6 edges
See if it has 6 rectangle faces
See if it is small enough to hold
questions.explain: A rectangular prism is any box with 6 rectangle faces, and squares count as rectangles. Size does not matter, so a tiny sugar cube is still a rectangular prism.

questions.question: Liam sorts boxes. Every box with 6 rectangle faces goes in the blue bin. Does his cube-shaped box go in the blue bin?
options: No, its faces are all squares
No, a cube has 8 flat faces
No, a cube has 12 flat faces
questions.explain: Squares are rectangles with equal sides, so a cube really does have 6 rectangle faces and belongs in the blue bin. A cube has 6 faces; the 8 is how many corners it has.

questions.question: Noah stacks a cube block on top of a longer prism block. He says both blocks have the same number of vertices. Is Noah right?
questions.explain: A cube and a rectangular prism each have 8 vertices, 12 edges and 6 faces, so Noah is right. The 6 belongs to the faces, so do not use it for the corners.

questions.question: Ana says a long rectangular prism has more faces than a cube. Why is she wrong?
options: A cube really has 8 flat faces
A cube is not a prism at all
questions.explain: Making a prism longer only stretches its faces; it never adds new ones, so a cube and a long prism both have 6 faces. Length changes the size of the faces, not how many there are.

questions.question: Zoe's block has 6 rectangle faces. Two faces are 4 cm by 4 cm. The other faces are 4 cm by 9 cm. Is the block a cube?
options: No, a cube has 8 flat faces
questions.explain: A cube needs every edge the same length, so all 6 faces are the same square. Zoe's block has longer 4 cm by 9 cm faces, so it is a rectangular prism but not a cube.

questions.question: A cube and a rectangular prism have the same number of edges. Together the two objects have 24 edges. How many edges does the prism have?
questions.explain: The 24 edges split evenly between the two shapes, so 12 + 12 = 24 and the prism has 12. Both shapes have 12 edges; the 8 counts corners and the 6 counts faces.
